Project: **Go AST Inspector**—standalone Go AST extraction and browser visualization, distributed as one HTML file. Stack: TypeScript 5.x, Svelte 5.x, Go WebAssembly, Vite 5.x, Biome 1.x. UI language: English. Go packages: `go/ast`, `go/parser`, `go/token`.

Before implementation, read `REQUIREMENTS.md` (FR-001–FR-006, NFR-001–NFR-006, technology decisions, MVP scope) and `DESIGN.md` (architecture, directories, Svelte components, build configuration, data flow). Follow the design’s WebAssembly, application-logic, and UI layers; use Svelte Writable Store: `astStore`, `parseErrorStore`, `selectedNodeStore`, `expandedNodesStore`. Use `vite-plugin-singlefile` to inline JS/CSS/WASM.

TypeScript strict mode; explicit types and typed props; avoid magic numbers (use constants). Use Svelte 5 runes (`$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`); components follow single responsibility. BEM recommended. Global styles: `src/styles/global.css`; component styles in `<style>`.

MUST convention: Prohibit redundant comments (no explanation needed for simple operations)
SHOULD convention: Write comments where code intent is hard to convey
MUST convention: Write commit messages in English
MUST convention: Write Pull Request titles and descriptions in English
MUST convention: Add GPG sign to all commits
MUST convention: Add Claude as Co-Author:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Co-Authored-By: Claude <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>
MUST convention: Run `npm run lint` before committing
MUST convention: Run `npm run type-check` before committing
If either command exits with an error, fix the issues before committing
Lint errors: Run `npm run format` to auto-fix formatting issues
Type errors: Fix type mismatches in the reported files

Priority: `REQUIREMENTS.md` > `DESIGN.md`. Report contradictions to user and request confirmation. Check both documents first; Ask user if not documented; Do not implement based on independent judgment. For issues, check build configuration in `DESIGN.md`, check `package.json` dependencies, and analyze error messages in detail.

Use Go parser only for Go AST analysis. Testing is not included in MVP but recommended for quality assurance.
